<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />

Built **Orbital Forge**, a playable top-down space-engineering game in the existing project.

- Fly through an open asteroid field, mine ore, collect fuel, and return to Kestrel Outpost.
- Deliver ore and place solar arrays, reactors, thrusters, and storage modules to complete the mission.
- Added a station, planetary landmarks, asteroid deposits, HUD, build palette, and mission progress.

**Controls:** WASD to fly, Shift to boost, E to mine, R to refuel, C to deliver, click to place a structure, or use 1–4 to select a build.

Verified the game loads without browser errors and mining adds ore. Screenshot: `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

**Assumption:** I interpreted “realistic” as a resource-and-engineering-focused, single-player 2D space sandbox rather than a full 3D simulation.
